desc:
🧟 Not everyone who enters the base is human...

The outbreak is spreading. Your job is to inspect every survivor, uncover hidden infections, and protect the last safe zone. 🚨

🔍 Scan people before they enter the shelter
🧪 Use advanced detection tools to find infected individuals
📋 Check documents, supplies, and suspicious behavior
⚖️ Make critical decisions: let them in... or stop the threat
💰 Earn rewards and upgrade your security equipment

⚠️ Every day brings new dangers. Infected creatures are getting smarter, and one wrong decision could destroy the entire base.

👹 Fight powerful infected bosses attempting to break through your defenses
⚔️ Defend humanity’s final shelter and survive the invasion
🏆 Unlock upgrades, rare rewards, and achievements

📱 Playable on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console

🧟 Can you become the ultimate Infection Inspector and protect the last survivors?
